title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16
source: AKG 414 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S/TDK MA-R)

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording captures a generally beautiful 1982 show with high energy, though some listeners note a surprising country turn on “El Paso.”
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its pleasant audience mix that softens the usual harshness of early‑’80s soundboards, delivering a clear and enjoyable listening experience. Fans describe the performance as "smoking" and high‑energy, but one reviewer felt the band sounded more like a country act after a few songs, highlighting “El Paso” as a low point.

ai_rating.rationale: Two upbeat comments about sound and energy versus one negative comment on the musical direction; recording is seen as good but not exceptional, yielding a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience mix smooths the harshness typical of ’82 soundboards, providing a pleasant and relatively clear sound despite lacking studio‑level crispness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set pacing; reviewers focus on overall vibe rather than song order.
